assumptions: noise: Gaussian, independent between sources, catalogue covariance (or scan-law shape with catalogue trace)

systematic: along-scan error constant over blocks of 10 s / 600 s / 6 h of one FOV stream, independent between blocks and FOVs, propagated through a 5-parameter along-scan least squares per NSIDE-64 pixel of the commanded scan law; source coupling blind, linear in BP-RP or linear in G

amplitude: the largest of three NSIDE-16 pixel-power measurements (upper 97.5%; complement auto power, complement and Quaia random-half cross power) is attributed to the modelled systematic; real Gaia systematics with other spatial/temporal structure are not covered

no cosmological signal in the mocks; the observed R106 value is compared with the mock distribution (rank only, no calibrated p: the systematic model is not a qualified description of the Gaia error budget)

script_versions.note: Receipts in the pre_fix groups were written before gaia_estimator.provenance() hashed the __main__ script, so they carry no gaia_scan_null.py SHA-256 (their gaia_estimator.py SHA-256 is recorded per kind). The pre_fix_A / pre_fix_B split is the only receipt-visible difference between those earlier versions. replay_check reruns the first draws of every stored run (same kind, seed, calibration and amplitude) with the current script, whose SHA-256 is recorded in the replay receipt; BIT_IDENTICAL means every stored array agrees bit for bit on those draws, i.e. the stored run is reproduced by that identified script version for the compared draws (later draws of the same loop are not re-executed).

units: Q dimensionless; amplitudes relative to the calibrated amplitude
